run_dual_guided_generation: run the VersatileDiffusionDualGuidedPipeline to generate images guided by both text prompts and input images
remove_unused_weights: remove the text_unet module from the pipeline to reduce memory usage after loading
convert_to_dual_attention: convert the image UNet transformer blocks to DualTransformer2DModel blocks that combine image and text UNet attention
encode_text_prompt: encode a text prompt into CLIP text embeddings for use as conditional guidance in the diffusion pipeline
encode_image_prompt: encode an input image into CLIP image embeddings for use as conditional guidance in the diffusion pipeline
